sentences.text: Paramore is an American rock band from Franklin , Tennessee , formed in 2004 .	rock	Rock music
The band currently consists of lead vocalist Hayley Williams , guitarist Taylor York and drummer Zac Farro .	Hayley Williams	Hayley Williams	Taylor York	Taylor York	Zac Farro	Zac Farro

The group released its debut album All We Know Is Falling in 2005 , with the album reaching number eight on the UK Rock Chart and number thirty on Billboards Heatseekers Chart .	All We Know Is Falling	All We Know Is Falling	UK Rock Chart	UK Rock Chart	Heatseekers Chart	Top Heatseekers

While it only had a minimal commercial performance initially , the album and its lead single `` Pressure '' were eventually certified Gold by the RIAA after the success of the band 's later material .	Pressure	Pressure (Paramore song)	RIAA	RIAA
Due to the success of the singles `` Misery Business '' , `` Crushcrushcrush '' , and `` That 's What You Get '' , Riot !	Misery Business	Misery Business	Crushcrushcrush	Crushcrushcrush
was a mainstream success and was certified Platinum in the United States .	Platinum	RIAA Certification
They then received a Best New Artist nomination at the 2008 Grammy Awards .	Best New Artist	Best New Artist	2008 Grammy Awards	50th Annual Grammy Awards	Grammy	Grammy Award

Their 2009 follow-up , Brand New Eyes , is the band 's second-highest charting album to date , landing at number two on the Billboard 200 with 175,000 first week sales .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	Brand New Eyes	Brand New Eyes

It produced the top-forty single `` The Only Exception '' and went platinum in Ireland and the UK , as well as gold in the US , Canada , Australia , and New Zealand .	The Only Exception	The Only Exception
Following the departure of Josh and Zac Farro in 2010 , the band released their self-titled fourth album in 2013 .	Zac Farro	Zac Farro	Josh	Josh Farro	self-titled fourth album	Paramore (album)

It gave the band their first career number one on the US Billboard 200 and was also the number one album in the United Kingdom , Ireland , Australia , New Zealand , Brazil , Argentina and Mexico .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

It included the singles `` Still Into You '' and `` Ai n't It Fun '' , with the latter winning the Grammy Award for Best Rock Song for Hayley Williams and Taylor York as songwriters , making it Paramore 's first Grammy win . The band 's lineup changed once again after this album cycle with bassist Jeremy Davis leaving the band near the end of 2015 and former drummer Zac Farro rejoining the band in 2017 .	Zac Farro	Zac Farro	Jeremy Davis	Jeremy Davis
